Print the Fibonacci series up to N terms.

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter number of terms: "))
a, b = 0, 1
for _ in range(n):
    print(a, end=" ")
    a, b = b, a + b
Note: The series must start at 0, 1. Use _ when the loop variable is not needed.
